# planar.types: OrientedBox2D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A rectangle with arbitrary rotation: Size gives the full width and height
> along the box's local axes, rotated by Rotation about Center
> (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oriented\_bounding\_box).

